text: The Energy and Power Engineering major is a comprehensive engineering discipline centered around "the development, conversion, utilization of energy and the design of related power systems". It focuses on addressing the core issues of energy production, supply, efficient utilization, and sustainable development. It integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as energy science, power engineering, and thermophysics, and is a key discipline that supports energy security, industrial production, and the transition to a low-carbon society in modern society.
